    Gravenhurst Resident Charged With Ten Counts Of Mischief

    By
    Muskoka411 Staff
    -
    October 14, 2026 9:36 pm
    Facebook
    Twitter
    Pinterest
    WhatsApp
      Listen to audio version of this article
      Sponsored by
      0:00 / 1:12
      Instaread

      The Bracebridge Detachment of the Ontario Provincial Police (OPP) has charged a fourth person in relation to an investigation involving multiple acts of mischief that occurred in Gravenhurst.

      On Wednesday, September 16, 2026, Bracebridge OPP officers responded to multiple reports of mischief that occurred during the very early morning hours in the town of Gravenhurst. Parked vehicles were damaged after rocks were thrown from a moving vehicle resulting in smashed windows. Ten vehicles were reportedly damaged that were parked on First Street South, Winewood Avenue West, Muskoka Road South, Main Street and Oriole Crescent. Three Port Sydney youths, aged 14, 16 and 17 years old, were each charged with 10 counts of Mischief.

      On October 14, 2026, as a result of the ongoing investigation, police arrested and charged 20-year-old Wesley French, of Gravenhurst, with Mischief X 10 and Obstruct Peace Officer.

      Discover more

      He will appear in the Ontario Court of Justice in Bracebridge on November 10, 2026 to answer to his charges.

      Anyone with information is asked to call Bracebridge OPP at 1-888-310-1122. If you remain wish to remain anonymous, you may reach out to Crime Stoppers at 1-800-222-TIPS (8477) or crimestopperssdm.com. Incident number for reference is E261347571.
